snippet.title: Where The Road Fades Trailer
snippet.description:
“Where the Road Fades” is a short psychological indie horror game. After an accident, you find yourself lost in the woods and seek help in a nearby house, but something isn’t right there. Explore your surroundings, make decisions, and face the darkness. Will you find your way out?
Now on Steam!
